bundle.shortDescription: The cross-platform aphrody CLI, in a native M3 desktop shell.
bundle.longDescription: aphrody desktop runs the full aphrody CLI in-process (Rust to Rust, no subprocess) and renders its output in a Material 3 webview. Reverse engineering, forensics, scanning, chat, image generation and more, behind a default-deny capability surface.
